meaning: Explicit program-to-area adapter. Existing parcel and geometry modules retain their own verification and unknowns; no feasibility or legal building program is inferred.

average_net_home_sf.rationale: Analyst scenario selected from verified finite search 2028750045-h60-p0. Area assumptions only; no lawful envelope, layout, availability or delivered-home finding. Financial model is retained separately. Net sf per proposed home; the legacy area module reports fractional home-equivalents.

gross_area_sf.rationale: Analyst scenario selected from verified finite search 2028750045-h60-p0. Area assumptions only; no lawful envelope, layout, availability or delivered-home finding. Financial model is retained separately.

nonresidential_gross_sf.rationale: Analyst scenario selected from verified finite search 2028750045-h60-p0. Area assumptions only; no lawful envelope, layout, availability or delivered-home finding. Financial model is retained separately. Nonresidential share is 1 minus the explicit residential share of gross.

residential_net_efficiency.rationale: Analyst scenario selected from verified finite search 2028750045-h60-p0. Area assumptions only; no lawful envelope, layout, availability or delivered-home finding. Financial model is retained separately. Declared net/residential-gross conversion, not a floor plan.
